description: This file defines a class JwtTokenGenerator responsible for creating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) using specified issuer options and signing credentials. It implements token creation with claims for subject, JWT ID, and issued at time.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates JWT tokens based on provided issuer options and signing credentials.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a JWT token string for a given username, embedding claims such as subject, JWT ID, and issued timestamp.
